# ASRS sell-price sheet
[textlink="Back to Mining & Industry" link="CMUGuideIndustry"] · [textlink="RUMC Machine Recipes" link="CMUGuideIndustryRecipes"]
The sheet lists opening prices for locally produced goods. All cargo lifts share one off-world buyer. Each round, the buyer pays full price for the first 2,000 credits of each product and half price for the next 2,000 at listed value. After that, demand for that product is exhausted. Other products have their own demand.
Use the ASRS appraisal tool on your packed crate to see its current offer. The lift takes the whole shipment, including excess stock. Fractional credits carry over to the faction’s next sale. Ordinary wood, glass and plastic supplies receive a lower buyback price.
Use the search box above to find a product or price. The sheet reads the same price prototypes used by the ASRS, so its values update automatically with the economy.
